appraisal_events.evidence: Tu te rappelles mon admiration pour lui ? ... C'est qu'elle a chez elle au moins un très beau tableau d'Elstir.
appraisal_events.explanation: One speaker recalls a past admiration for Elstir and cites owning a very beautiful Elstir painting as a reason to seek out an unnamed lady, treating Elstir's work as a mark of value worth pursuing.

status_effects.explanation: Elstir is mildly elevated as an object of stated admiration and as a painter whose work is treated as a compelling reason to know its owner.
